Level: 120 Form: Insect A giant, flying Dragon that appears in the dragon forests. He patrols the dragon forests, kidnapping invaders and Halflingers. This has caused rumors that anyone who touches the shadow of Dragonoir will be pulled into darkness. He is a pet that is being raised by the unidentified Dragon Rider, a servant of Horn Tail.

Level: 39 Form: Enchanted A machine monster that has popped up in the arcade in Kerning Square. Put a coin in and you can manipulate the claw to pull out one of the many dolls inside. It may appear easy at first, but it's hard to nab the exact doll you want.

Lv. : 100 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against holy attacks, little damage against lighting and fire-based attacks, and unaffected against poison-based attacks. The head of the NInjas. Because of the past battles within the castle, he reached a number of life and death situations, and... no one can confirm whether he's really alive or not.

Lv. : 105 Form : Reptile A group of young dragons that live in the nest. Ever since their amicable relationship with the Halflingers came to an end, they have been left unattended without the protection that Halflingers once supplied. The Jr. Newties cannot leave their nests, but they have the power to attack using a sound wave at a distance. When the Jr. Newties are attacked, a messenger of the nest that protect the Jr. Newties appears.

Lv. : 105 Form : Reptile Special Trait : -50% Fire Attribute Damage. Vulnerable to Ice Attribute Attacks. An evil monster of the dragon family that lives in Manon's Forest. It is considered a high-ranking dragon, boasting various magic skills as well as high level of intelligence. Its physical strength also contributes to the challenge for adventurers battling against this monster, as it is covered by a firm outer layer and has a breath that can melt even the toughest metals. It can also fly using its small wings. The Manons had an amicable relationship with the Halflingers, but for an unknown reason, they have become hostile towards one another.

Lv. : 120 Form : Immortal Special Trait : Weak against lightning, ice, and fire-based attacks, but unaffected against poison. A ninja that perished years ago at a chaotic battle in the confines of Ninja Castle, but has been floating around the castle as a ghost, unable to let go of the past.

Lv. : 180 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against poison-based attacks. A toad monster that had extended its life for an unfathomably long time. Enticed the real emperor to go with him, and has been in control of the Ninja Castle since. Receive enough damage, and it'll show its true colors. No one has yet to spot the real emperor.

Lv. : 25 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against poison and fire-based attacks. A Low-tier Ninja that has been diligently training at the Ninja Town. The skills may not be on par with the Ninjas of higher level, but their penchant for blades cannot be ignored.

Lv. : 30 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against lightning and poison-based attacks. A soldier that believes that the emperor inside the castle is the real deal. Uses a spear that he's not accustomed to using.

Lv. : 50 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against lightning-based and fire-based attacks. A Mid-tier Ninja that worked himself up from Low-tier Ninja. An expert at threatening the masses with throwing stars. Watch out for a black, shadowy figure behind. your. back.

Lv. : 56 Form : Mammal Special Trait : Vulnerable to Fire Attribute Attacks. Vulnerable to Sanctity Attribute Attacks. A Samiho that can be found near the Korean Folk Town. It is striving to become a Nine-Tailed Fox, but only has three tails as it is still in the process of training. It has taken over an entire valley of the Black Mountain, practicing magic by casting a curse on the passersby; hence, the adventurers exploring the Fox Ridge should always remain alert and cautious.

Lv. : 60 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against fire-based attacks, but unaffected against holy attacks. A female ninja that was trained at Ninja Town. Used to live the life of a regular girl until one day, her fiance got brutally murdered by a monster. She has dedicated her life to combat ever since. Her expertise is stealth observation, but ever since the Ninja Castle got sieged, she stopped hiding herself and started engaging in the combat.

Lv. : 62 Form : Devil The spirit of a scholar who had an unfortunate encounter with the Samiho 30 years ago, on his way to take the service exam to become a government official. The spirit, who still harbors residual grudge for not having been able to fulfill his dreams, lingers around the Fox Ridge to solicit the help of passersby. It is said that offering the tail of the Samiho to the stone tower, somewhere in the Fox Ridge, would relieve the grudge of this spirit.

Lv. : 70 Form : Mammal A three-tailed fox, also known as a Samiho, that transformed into a Nine-Tailed-Fox through an extensive training of magic. Its fur is silverish, bluish moon-like color, and this fox monster can be found in the Fox Ridge of Black Mountain, waiting to prey on the lives in Korean Folk Town. It has sharp claws, powerful magic skills, and Samihoes that serve as subordinates that render this monster a challenging enemy to defeat, but the most dangerous quality of this monster comes from its cunningness that can easily deceive people. It likes to seduce people by disguising as a human, so be cautious when you come across an attractive lady at the foot of the Black Mountain.

Lv. : 72 Form : Spirit Special Trait : Vulnerable to Poison Attribute Attacks. A dwarf spirit that lives in Minar Forest. It has an ugly face but even an uglier personality, so you must be cautious when approaching this monster. It steals from people, but cannot figure out how or for what the belongings are used. It is always in raggedy clothes, and an unconfirmed rumor has it that Hobi was banished from the town after committing a crime that turned this monster into a useless, heinous creature. Once a Halflinger, the Hobis are not particularly fond of the Halflingers.

Lv. : 76 Form : Spirit Special Trait : -50% Poison Attribute Damage. A dwarf spirit that lives in Minar Forest. As the lead warrior of the Hobis, the Green Hobi is in a more fashionable attire, though not by much. Although it displays battle prowess, handling objects isn't a forte for this monster, much like a regular Hobi. The Halflingers despise this monster, for it likes to attack their town and steal whatever it can get its hands on.

Lv. : 80 Form : Human Special Trait : Weak against holy attacks, but is unaffected against ice-based attacks. A Mid-tier Ninja that worked himself all the way to the high-tier Ninja. Deeply injured at a training against an ice-based attack.

Lv. : 90 Form : Mammal According to legend, this creature was born between a human and a Snow Spirit. It has the soul of a human, but was born with the appearance of a monster -- which caused him much grief growing up, as he was constantly taunted by other humans. The Snow Spirit, who watched Nyalmo's sad situation, froze up an entire mountain range, just for Nyalmo, and called it El Nath. Nyalmo doesn't like humans, and hence stays away from them as much as possible, but he'd never attack a human first on his own. However, he will mercilessly attack anyone who breaks the Fragment of the Snow Spirit.

Lv. : Unknown Form : Reptile The first dragon that's ever stood up against the dragon chief, Nine Spirit, who was the former ruler over Minar Forest. Horntail assembled an army of evil dragons to create an evil force that instigated the historically-known Dragon War. Horntail seemed to be the more powerful one at the beginning, but Nine Spirit's longstanding experience and wisdom as a leader seemed to overpower Horntail's inexperience. In the end, Horntail broke the Pact between the dragons and Halflingers and attacked the Halflingers' village, stealing the egg of Nine Spirit which they were protecting. This was a crime that no dragon known as the guardian of order should have committed. Ultimately, Horntail overthrew the reign of Nine Spirit, and the forest was conquered by the demonic servants of Horntail. Since then, no traces of true, honorable dragons could be found in the forest. Horntail, who has three heads and, subsequently, three different minds, is currently hiding in a cave to heal his wounds, and plotting to rule the regions even past Leafre using the egg of Nine Spirit.

This class has a variety of buff skills to support allies. Its holy power skills, such as Holy Fountain and Holy Water, restore HP even when party members aren't nearby. Dispel can remove abnormal status effects, and Resurrection can even revive dead party members. However, when you use Righteously Indignant to change the Angel of Benevolence to the Avenging Angel, the supportive Benevolence skills will instead become powerful Revenge skills. With that in mind, this class can be flexible.

This class has beneficial skills that heal and support allies, such as the Angel of Benevolence. Conversely, the Angel of Benevolence can turn into the Avenging Angel, with skills specialized for attack.

This class hones its body into a living weapon, specializing in weakening enemies. Its affinity with the sea allows it to call the fearsome Sea Serpent for help in battle. The Sea Serpent skill periodically activates when using fighting skills. Activating the Serpent Scale, which gathers the traces that form every time the Sea Serpent materializes, allows use of the Assault skill, which is a more powerful Sea Serpent skill.
This class is a member of the Secret Garden, a secretive organization, which uses a pair of bladed weapons for flurries of devastating attacks.
This class mainly uses swords and axes, and possesses significant attack power. While attacking, you'll gain combo orbs, which can inflict great damage once fully charged.
This class specializes in Fire and Poison magic. Most attack skills inflict damage over time (DoT), and the attacks become stronger the more damage over time is inflicted.

This class specializes in lightning and ice magic. Ice attacks have a Freezing effect. Attacking with a powerful lightning magic, on an enemy that has Freezing effect stacks, will inflict even more damage.
This class specializes in showering enemies with throwing stars from long range. More than that, many of the stars are imbued with magical talismans, which can attack enemies over a wide area.

This class specializes in spears and polearms, weapons with a long reach. It also summons the Evil Eye, a messenger of darkness, which can be used in various ways in battle. The contract with darkness allows a Dark Knight to ignore death, even after reaching 0 HP, and punish enemies for their insolence.

This class specializes in using bows for long-ranged attacks. It also carries special arrowheads, which can be swapped out according to the situation. With its rapid-fire archery, which often leaves an afterimage, this class keeps enemies pinned down nonstop.
This class specializes in using crossbows for long-ranged attacks. Each time you fire a certain number of shots, the next shot fills with powerful energy.
This class uses knuckle-based fighting techniques to suppress enemies. With the power of the Sea Serpent, which materializes automatically when using fighting skills, it can deal additional attacks.
This class utilizes Holy Power skills to increase its Attack Power and reduce damage taken. It can also conjure a hammer from pure light.

This class wields daggers, hiding behind a smokescreen or in the shadows before assassinating enemies with deadly consecutive attacks. Uses various skills in conjunction with Mesos, representing luck.
This class wields Hand Cannons to launch powerful long-range attacks. It also comes complete with a monkey, who assists with heavy bombing attacks.

When Piercing Arrow or Snipe hit a certain number of times, an Empowered technique kicks in, allowing you to use a powerful Empowered Piercing Arrow or Empowered Snipe in the next attack.
